title: CD4LM: Consistency Distillation and aDaptive Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.02236v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) accelerate generation by decoding multiple tokens in parallel, but pushing them to fast decoding often sacrifices accuracy. We attribute this to a static-to-dynamic mismatch: training optimizes local denoising under fixed schedules, while fast inference skips steps and encounters irregular mask patterns. Existing accelerators largely address only one side of this problem. Training-free inference methods speed up decoding without changing the model, leaving the mismatch unresolved; training-side distillation methods adapt the model, but often tie the student to a specific decoding trajectory, limiting composability and still suffering accuracy loss. We propose CD4LM, a composable framework for accurate DLM acceleration. translated_title: CD4LM：面向扩散语言模型的一致性蒸馏与自适应解码
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过并行解码多个 token 来加速生成，但在追求快速解码时往往会牺牲准确性。我们将这一现象归因于静态与动态之间的不匹配：训练阶段是在固定调度下优化局部去噪，而快速推理则跳步执行并遇到不规则的掩码模式。现有加速方法大多只解决该问题的其中一个方面：免训练的推理方法在不改变模型的情况下加速解码，但未能消除这种不匹配；训练侧的蒸馏方法虽然让模型适应了加速推理，但通常将学生模型绑定在特定的解码轨迹上，限制了可组合性，且仍存在准确性损失。我们提出 CD4LM，一个用于精确加速扩散语言模型的可组合框架。其核心训练组件——离散空间一致性蒸馏（DSCD）——在多样化的掩码状态下训练出轨迹不变的学生模型，从而在不固定解码轨迹的前提下减少上述不匹配……
tldr: CD4LM 提出一个可组合的加速框架，通过离散空间一致性蒸馏训练轨迹不变的模型并配合自适应解码，在不牺牲准确性的前提下加速扩散语言模型的生成。
en_tdlr: CD4LM proposes a composable acceleration framework for diffusion language models that combines Discrete-Space Consistency Distillation, training a trajectory-invariant student on diverse masked states, with adaptive decoding to achieve fast decoding without sacrificing accuracy.
